marketSummary: Indian equities staged a sharp recovery to snap a four-day losing streak, with the Nifty 50 rebounding from intraday lows of 22,387 to settle at 22,753.20 (+0.68%) and Sensex closing at 73,606.75 (+0.66%). Breadth improved markedly in broader markets, with Midcap and Smallcap benchmarks climbing over 1.1%. In the current session, benchmark indices are digesting gains near 22,700 as elevated Brent crude ($114–$115/bbl) and cautionary global cues ahead of central bank decisions cap aggressive upside. Tactical swing opportunities remain concentrated in selective earnings outgrowths and order-driven capital goods/defence setups.
dailyFocus: Track continuation breakouts in Capital Goods and Defence following massive government procurement clearances (DAC's ₹2.12 lakh crore AoN approval) and high-leverage earnings surprises (CG Power, Mankind Pharma), while managing risk ahead of Trent's detailed Q2 release on October 28.

sectors.name: Defence & Aerospace
sectors.reason: Exceptional medium-term visibility backed by the Defence Acquisition Council's (DAC) fresh clearance of ₹2.12 lakh crore procurement proposals across helicopters, air defence, and radar systems.
catalysts: DAC Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) approvals totaling ₹2.12 lakh crore with ~82% domestic sourcing mandate
Ongoing order execution ramp-up in radar, avionics, and naval platforms
risks: Lumpy conversion timelines from AoN stage to binding commercial contracts
Extended supply lead times for specialized sub-assemblies

sectors.name: Capital Goods & Electrical Equipment
sectors.reason: Strong earnings delivery and capacity expansions across power transmission and rail tech, bolstered by regulatory milestones such as RDSO Kavach 4.0 approval.

RDSO Kavach 4.0 approval clearing path for execution of ₹433 crore rail protection systems

sectors.name: Pharmaceuticals & Healthcare
sectors.reason: Solid volume growth and operating margin expansion in domestic formulations and chronic therapy segments providing a defensive shelter against macro volatility.

Secondary market prescription sales outpacing broader Indian Pharmaceutical Market growth
risks: Regulatory inspection outcomes at export-oriented formulation facilities

sectors.name: Retail & Consumer Discretionary
sectors.reason: Robust top-line network momentum countered by investor caution regarding mature-store productivity and premium multiples ahead of full quarterly prints.
catalysts: Trent's store network milestones (Zudio crossing 1,000 stores) and 23% standalone Q2 sales expansion
Festive demand boost across apparel and value-retail chains
risks: Pace of net store additions moderating compared to previous cycles
Potential operating margin compression from store-opening pre-operative costs

sectors.name: Power Financing & PSU Financials
sectors.reason: Underperformance driven by earnings contractions and provisioning pressures, with dividend support providing only a tactical cushion near multi-week lows.

Interim dividend declaration yielding near-term dividend-yield support

news.headline: CG Power Unit GG Tronics Receives RDSO Approval for Kavach 4.0, Enabling ₹433 Crore Order
news.summary: GG Tronics India, a subsidiary of CG Power and Industrial Solutions, secured formal RDSO approval for Kavach 4.0 on October 26, 2026. The approval satisfies the core pending condition required to commence execution on an existing ₹433 crore railway safety system contract.
news.impact: Removes regulatory overhang on railway execution, providing direct structural continuation fuel to the stock's post-earnings breakout.

news.headline: DAC Clears Capital Acquisition Proposals Worth ₹2.12 Lakh Crore for Armed Forces
news.summary: The Defence Acquisition Council (DAC) accorded Acceptance of Necessity (AoN) to procurement proposals worth approximately ₹2,12,000 crore on October 26, 2026. Around 82% will be sourced indigenously, including Light Multi-Role Helicopters, air defence systems, and radar networks.
news.impact: Expands multi-year addressable pipeline and reignites accumulation volume across prime aerospace and defence bases.

news.headline: Mankind Pharma Q2 PAT Rises 37.7% YoY to ₹716 Crore; EBITDA Margins Reach 27.1%
news.summary: Mankind Pharma reported a 17.3% YoY increase in Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue to ₹4,338 crore on October 26, 2026, with PAT jumping 37.7% to ₹716 crore. Operating margins expanded by 210 bps YoY to 27.1%, aided by 18.7% growth in cardiac therapy and 32.7% growth in exports.
news.impact: Triggers high-volume expansion out of a multi-week consolidation base, validating institutional accumulation on expanding margins.

news.headline: Trent Board to Consider Q2 Results on October 28 Following 23% Standalone Revenue Growth
news.summary: Trent Limited is scheduled to announce its detailed Q2 FY27 financial results on Wednesday, October 28, 2026. The print follows a preliminary business disclosure showing standalone merchandise revenues rose 23% YoY to ₹5,788 crore as the Zudio store footprint crossed 1,000 locations.
news.impact: Serves as an immediate binary catalyst where price action tests upper flag resistance ahead of formal margin and store productivity metrics.

news.headline: CG Power Q2 Consolidated PAT Rises 43.8% YoY to ₹409 Crore; Approves Capacity Capex
news.summary: CG Power and Industrial Solutions reported Q2 FY27 consolidated revenue of ₹3,801.54 crore (+30.1% YoY) and net profit of ₹409.09 crore (+43.8% YoY). Total income reached ₹3,883.25 crore, driven by robust industrial systems execution and fresh switchgear and transformer manufacturing capex.
news.impact: Confirms fundamental earnings acceleration, reinforcing swing support along previous pivot resistance near ₹810–₹815.

news.headline: BEL Secures ₹770 Crore MoD Contract for Low Level Light Weight Radars
news.summary: Bharat Electronics signed a capital acquisition contract valued at ₹770 crore with the Ministry of Defence to supply indigenous Improved Low Level Light Weight Radars (LLLR-I) to the Indian Army, bringing cumulative new contract awards since mid-October 2026 to ₹1,011 crore.
news.impact: Provides steady order replenishment to support base-building action and cushion downside during broader market swings.

news.headline: KFin Technologies Surges 6% on Q2 Profit Outperformance and Thai Licence
news.summary: KFin Technologies gained 6% to an intraday high of ₹878.70 on October 27, 2026, after posting a 33.4% sequential increase in Q2 FY27 PAT to ₹100.3 crore and EBITDA margin expansion to 40.1%. Additionally, its Thai unit obtained a Foreign Business Licence from Thailand's Ministry of Commerce.
news.impact: Produces an oversold mean-reversion bounce off multi-month swing lows, retesting descending moving averages on high volume.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard Subsidiary UCSL Launches First 6,300 DWT Cargo Vessel for Norway's Wilson ASA
news.summary: Udupi Cochin Shipyard (UCSL), a wholly owned subsidiary of Cochin Shipyard, launched the first 6,300 DWT dry cargo vessel of an eight-ship export contract for Wilson ASA at Malpe on October 26, 2026. At 99 metres long, it is the largest vessel constructed at the yard to date.
news.impact: Milestone delivery execution on European export contracts helps stabilize price inside a multi-week re-accumulation range.

news.headline: REC Posts Q2 PAT of ₹3,478 Crore; Declares ₹3.50 Per Share Interim Dividend
news.summary: REC Limited reported a 21.2% YoY drop in Q2 FY27 consolidated PAT to ₹3,477.73 crore on October 26, 2026, as operating revenue dipped 1% to ₹15,000.40 crore. The board declared an interim dividend of ₹3.50 per share with a record date of October 30, 2026, while its loan book expanded 5% QoQ to ₹6.17 lakh crore.
news.impact: Net profit contraction creates overhead resistance near recent breakdown levels, though dividend capture interest provides a floor near immediate lows.

news.headline: Nifty Rebounds 365 Points from Intraday Lows to Settle at 22,753, Snapping Losing Run
news.summary: The Nifty 50 halted a four-session slide on October 26, 2026, recovering from a morning low of 22,387 to close at 22,753.20 (+153.20 points). Ten of 11 sectoral indices gained, led by Metal (+1.89%) and Pharma (+1.54%), as value buyers absorbed pressure from elevated crude prices.
news.impact: Establishes a constructive intraday demand tail at 22,380–22,400, but overhead supply at the 22,850 hurdle dictates selective setup discipline.
